scope: Alias-based delivery accounts, layered secret resolution, remote identity verification, permission preflight, and account-change reapproval

red_evidence.reason: the delivery account, credential provider, and preflight modules were absent

assertions: system credential storage takes priority over the explicit environment fallback
missing credentials block before any remote identity probe
a selected account resolving to a different remote identity is rejected before write
missing permissions do not silently select another account or delivery method
changing the approved account alias requires fresh approval
secret values never appear in preflight results or verification evidence

review.kind: separate primary-agent review because delegated review is disabled by session policy

live_blocker: The user authorized skipping the external account, so remote identity and permissions were not verified live.
